record.dic_text:
04326 Miyamin {me-yaw-meem'}

04509 的另一型; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Mijamin 4; 4

米雅民 = "右手而來的"
1) 大衛王所指派的第六班祭司的負責人 (#代上 24:9|)
2) 一位在與尼希米所訂的公約上簽名的祭司 (#尼 10:7|)
3) 一位隨所羅巴伯一同回歸的祭司 (#尼 12:5|)
4) 巴錄的子孫, 他曾娶了一外邦女子為妻 (#拉 10:25|)
record.edic_text:
04326 Miyamin {me-yaw-meem'}

a form for 04509;; n pr m

AV - Mijamin 4; 4

Mijamin = "from the right hand"
1) chief of the 6th course of priests established by David
2) a priest who signed the covenant with Nehemiah
3) a priest who went up with Zerubbabel
4) a priest who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
